title: Install OpenClaw and complete a first safe run
summary: Move from a clean host to a minimally configured assistant while keeping pairing and tool access constrained.
prerequisites: A supported host and a model provider account if the selected provider requires one.

title: Configure one messaging channel safely
summary: Add one channel with constrained credentials and prove delivery without exposing the Gateway broadly.
audience: Operators adding a first messaging integration
prerequisites: A working local Gateway and a dedicated test account or channel for the provider.

title: Audit a skill before installing it
summary: Inspect a skill's provenance permissions and behavior before allowing it into an OpenClaw workspace.
prerequisites: A disposable workspace and access to the skill source or registry metadata.

title: Deploy OpenClaw with Docker and sandboxing
summary: Create a reproducible container deployment with explicit mounts networking and tool-execution boundaries.
prerequisites: A host with Docker and a reviewed environment file that contains no committed secrets.

title: Recover a compromised or misconfigured Gateway
summary: Contain a suspicious Gateway state and rotate exposed credentials before restoring only reviewed configuration.
audience: Operators handling a security incident or unsafe configuration
prerequisites: Access to the host and provider consoles plus a known-good backup that excludes secrets.
